summary: A playground at Long Bridge and China Basin streets in Mission Bay, part of the Mission Bay Parks system (labeled P6 on OCII's current Mission Bay South open-space page), that opened to the public in 2016 after months of delay; the exact day is inconsistently reported across the two sources found.

milestones.text: Mission Bay Kids' Park playground opens to the public

facts.value: P6 ("Kids Park"), per OCII's current Mission Bay South open-space page

sources.title: Kids' Park opens in Mission Bay
New Mission Bay Kids' Park Opens Friday!
Mission Bay South: Open Space
sources.publisher: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org)

open_questions: Exact opening date is unresolved: the Urban Life Signs blog post says the playground opened Friday, July 1, 2016; Mission Bay Parks' own post announcing the opening is dated September 15, 2016 and doesn't state a specific day, raising the possibility of a later or phased opening than the blog's July date -- flagged rather than picked.
Neither source names a designer, landscape architect or general contractor.
